translations.web: My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.
translations.bsb: In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
translations.kjv: Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.
translations.asv: My soul waiteth in silence for God only: From him cometh my salvation.
